answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent network can mandate Proof of Space-Time. A protocol beacon issues periodic queries against pre-allocated disk sectors, which nodes must answer within milliseconds. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of dedicating scarce physical storage per identity; an ephemeral cluster cannot flash through like a comet without falling off the verification ledge. However, this mechanism rewards industrial storage hoarding and strains disk longevity.
